crossRefs.note: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s…
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges…
When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…

people.name: Athaliah
people.line: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.
translations.bsb: and all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet, because Athaliah had been put to the sword.
translations.kjv: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
translations.asv: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. And Athaliah they had slain with the sword.
